steps.text: Use the subagent tool TWICE in the SAME assistant message (two parallel tool calls in one response): both calls are byte-identical twins — description 'Say the word BETA', prompt 'Reply with exactly the word BETA and nothing else.', run_in_background false. The composition under test disables the same-step duplicate reuse guard, so both twin delegations spawn a live child. After both subagents return, reply with the single word PARENT_DONE and stop. Do not use the bash tool.
